answerSupportLlmStage.note: Only model available to the answer-support validator LLM stage under current key/authorization.

mitigation: Because stronger judge models are authorization-denied, safety-critical correctness is not delegated to the LLM stage. Deterministic fail-closed guards (treatment-contradiction, material-exception-omission, outcome-prediction) run BEFORE the LLM stage and OVERRIDE LLM approval. The DIRECT schema validator and trust-contract accessor hardening ensure a malformed/accessor verdict fails closed regardless of model.
architectureNote: CLUSTER_SPECIFIC_WITH_FAIL_CLOSED_SCHEMA — guards are cluster-specific deterministic rules, not full operative-source-excerpt grounding. Full source-excerpt grounding is recorded as a P2 carryover.
